channel.title: The Grant Desk - next 90 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: next 90 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: The Elephant Trust: Autumn 2026 Grant Round (UK)
item.description: The Elephant Trust · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · Grants to visual artists of up to GBP 5,000; typical awards range GBP 2,000 to GBP 5,000. Projects with a total budget exceeding GBP 30,000 are not supported. No application fee.

item.title: National Parks Arts Foundation: Hawai'i Volcanoes National Park Residency, October 2027 (All Media)
item.description: National Parks Arts Foundation (NPAF) · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · USD 4,000 stipend, plus a month's housing in a three-bedroom house with recording booth, meditation area and art-studio conversion, about 30 minutes from park headquarters. Travel and required insurance are the artist's own responsibility. APPLICATION FEE: USD 60 single artist, USD 120 couple or duo, USD 160 group of 3 or more.

item.title: Onassis ONX: ONX Seeds 2026, Soft Circuits for Hard Times (Athens, hybrid)
item.description: Onassis ONX (Onassis Foundation) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,000 to 5,000 seed funding per project, set by scope; up to four projects selected. Plus weekly technical, curatorial and business mentoring, online masterclasses, studio and equipment access at Onassis Ready for Athens-based teams, and presentation at ONX Exhibition Athens (17 to 21 March 2027) with travel, accommodation and artwork transport covered for non-Athens participants. No application fee.

item.title: Propuestas VEGAP 2026: XXX Call for Visual Creation Grants
item.description: VEGAP (Visual Entidad de Gestion de Artistas Plasticos), Fondo Asistencial y Cultural · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 100,000 total: 20 grants of EUR 5,000 each. No application fee.

item.title: City of Timisoara Project Centre: Mobilities for Cultural Professionals 2026
item.description: Centrul de Proiecte al Municipiului Timisoara · deadline 27 Oct 2026 · Maximum RON 7,500 per national mobility; maximum RON 10,000 per international mobility. Non-reimbursable, with a required co-funding of at least 1% of the project budget. No application fee.

item.title: Fondation Vocatio: Bourse Vocatio 2027 (EUR 10,000 for young talents in Belgium)
item.description: Fondation Vocatio · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 bourse per laureate, funding a concrete personal project (equipment, production, training). No application fee.

item.title: Burning Man: BRC Honoraria Art Grants 2027 (Letter of Intent)
item.description: Burning Man Project · deadline 29 Oct 2026 · USD 1.5 million annual art-grant budget across approximately 75 projects; grants fund 40 to 60% of the proposed total budget, and the official page notes grants over USD 20,000 are rare. No fixed per-award figure is published. No application fee.

item.title: AFTER THE PALACE: Resonance 2026 Video Mapping Contest (Krakow)
item.description: University of the National Education Commission in Krakow (unLoc project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Cash prizes: PLN 10,000 (~EUR 2,340) first place, PLN 6,000 second, PLN 3,000 third; the jury may award additional honorary distinctions or redistribute the pool. Free to enter, submission is exclusively digital.

item.title: Finnish Cultural Foundation: October Round 2026 (all fields of art and science)
item.description: Finnish Cultural Foundation (Suomen Kulttuurirahasto) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Around EUR 49 million awarded annually across roughly 2,100 grants; recent October rounds have averaged over 450 working and project grants covering one or more years, with working grants extending up to four years. No application fee.

item.title: Movies that Matter Festival 2027: Film Submissions
item.description: Movies that Matter · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Cash prizes: EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Documentary award (winner also becomes eligible for consideration for the Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature), EUR 5,000 Grand Jury Fiction award, and EUR 1,500 Shorts award; further competitions (Activist Lens, Justice Frame, Dutch Focus, Education Award, Audience Award) publish no amounts. SUBMISSION FEE: EUR 25 until 30 September 2026, EUR 35 late fee 1 October to 1 November 2026; fee waivers only in very exceptional cases.

item.title: Nordic Culture Fund: ENTER 2026 (exploratory cross-border collaboration)
item.description: Nordic Culture Fund · deadline 16 Oct 2026 · Up to DKK 50,000 (roughly EUR 6,700), plus up to DKK 25,000 in additional accessibility support for logistics and access needs, for a maximum total of DKK 75,000. No co-funding required. No application fee.

item.title: Struts Gallery: Open Studio Residency Program 2027 (Sackville, New Brunswick)
item.description: Struts Gallery · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · CAD 3,250 artist fee, CAD 30 per diem (CAD 750 total for 25 working days), travel costs up to CAD 800, and CAD 200 towards materials for workshops or other public events. Residents also get 24-hour access to a roughly 400 sq ft studio, a private furnished two-bedroom apartment above the gallery, and access to the centre's media arts equipment and facilities.

item.title: Arts Convergences Video Prize, 6th edition (short films on mental illness)
item.description: Arts Convergences, in partnership with Thanks for Nothing · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 total: Grand Prize EUR 2,000, Jury Prize EUR 1,500, Public Choice Prize EUR 1,500 (online vote). Additional prizes may be awarded. No entry fee.

item.title: La Biennale di Venezia: Biennale College Blend, 2nd edition (EUR 20,000 award)
item.description: La Biennale di Venezia · deadline 19 Oct 2026 · One Biennale College Blend Award of EUR 20,000 to the most compellingly structured project. Accommodation covered for the Venice workshop (travel not covered). No application fee.

item.title: Transluce: Governance & Policy Fellow (San Francisco)
item.description: Transluce · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year salary plus benefits. Full-time; part-time possible for exceptional candidates.

item.title: World of Art / SCCA-Ljubljana: Award for Curatorial Practices 2026

No application fee.

item.title: Asymmetry Assistant Curator Fellowship 2027-2029 at Nottingham Contemporary
item.description: Asymmetry Art Foundation, with Nottingham Contemporary · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Annual salary of GBP 27,556 for two years, plus pension and National Insurance contributions, annual leave in line with organisational policy plus UK bank holidays, visa and legal fee assistance where required, and a travel and relocation allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Sanford Underground Research Facility: Artist-in-Residence Program 2027 (Lead, South Dakota)
item.description: Sanford Underground Research Facility (SURF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend paid in two installments, plus up to USD 5,000 in additional funds the artist may apply for to create the artwork. Transportation (airfare, rental car or mileage), housing and per diem are covered for both visits; a studio space and guided surface and underground tours are provided; return shipping of the exhibition is covered up to USD 7,000.

item.title: EFFEA Call #5: European Festivals Fund for Emerging Artists
item.description: European Festivals Association (EFA) · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · 50 residency grants: 40 Discovery grants of EUR 8,000 (for artists at an early career stage) and 10 Springboard grants of EUR 15,000 (for artists established at home and ready to break through internationally). A minimum of 80 percent of the grant must cover costs incurred by the artists (fees, travel, accommodation, subsistence). An own contribution of EUR 1,000 (Discovery) or EUR 2,000 (Springboard) is deducted from the paid grant. No application fee.

item.title: Harry Ransom Center Research Fellowships 2027-2028 (Austin, Texas)
item.description: Harry Ransom Center, The University of Texas at Austin · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · Postdoctoral Fellowships: USD 3,500 per month for one or two months. Dissertation Fellowships: USD 2,500. Travel Stipends: USD 2,000 (open to graduate students, faculty and independent researchers including artists and journalists). International recipients get an extra USD 500. No application fee.

item.title: La Nueva Fabrica Residency 2027-2028 (Antigua, Guatemala)
item.description: La Nueva Fabrica (LNF) · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend, plus free housing in an equipped on-site house, airport transfers, curatorial and logistical support, and access to community programming. Five residents selected annually. No application fee.

item.title: Next Nature: Heaven's Hospital Open Call (commissions on the future of care)
item.description: Heaven's Hospital / Next Nature Museum · deadline 20 Oct 2026 · Three selected projects each receive a budget of EUR 15,000 for the development of a first prototype or artistic intervention. item.description: Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Think Tanger, Morocco · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,500 subsidy for a two-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL. No application fee.

item.title: Perform Europe: Open Call 2026-2028 (cross-border touring)
item.description: Perform Europe (co-funded by Creative Europe, European Union) · deadline 22 Oct 2026 · Three grant tiers: EUR 15,000 (small), EUR 25,000 (medium) or EUR 55,000 (large) per proposal, plus top-ups of up to EUR 5,000 for sustainability and accessibility needs; absolute maximum EUR 60,000 per proposal including top-ups. No application fee.

item.title: AI Philosophy Competition: First Edition
item.description: Zachary Goodsell and Elliott Thornley, funded by Forethought Research · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 3,000 first prize, USD 2,000 second, USD 1,000 third, plus a USD 5,000 pool for creative methodology distributed at the judges' discretion (USD 11,000 total). No entry fee.

item.description: Stichting Stokroos · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for individuals, EUR 7,500 for duos, EUR 10,000 for collectives, as an unrestricted contribution to a self-defined plan. No application fee.

item.title: Est-Nord-Est Artist Residency 2027-2028 (Saint-Jean-Port-Joli, Quebec)
item.description: Est-Nord-Est, residence d'artistes · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · CAD 2,080 residency honorarium, plus a free individual studio-workshop with lodging, access to specialized wood, metal and ceramics equipment, a documentation center, and technical, artistic and logistical support. Four artists per session. No application fee.

item.title: A.I.R. Gallery: Fellowship Program 2027-2028 (NYC)
item.description: A.I.R. Gallery · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · USD 3,000 stipend per fellow, plus a solo exhibition at A.I.R. Gallery, 4 to 5 professional development workshops, an assigned artist-mentor, a studio visit with a review panelist and ongoing staff support. Six fellows selected. No application fee stated.

item.title: Humanity AI: Open Call for Proposals 2026
item.description: Humanity AI (coalition of 10 philanthropies) · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · USD 10 million total pool, grants of USD 75,000 to 1,000,000 across three tiers: Tier 1 USD 75,000-150,000; Tier 2 USD 150,000-500,000; Tier 3 USD 500,000-1,000,000. item.title: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (Tate Britain x Delfina Foundation)
item.description: Tate, in collaboration with Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Fully funded 6-month fellowship: living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, single bedroom at Delfina Foundation (house of up to 8 residents with shared facilities), return economy flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement with visa support, London Underground and bus travel pass, a research resource allowance, and travel to other Tate galleries (Tate Modern, Liverpool, St Ives) and other UK and European cultural institutions. Two fellowships available. No application fee.

item.title: Stroom Den Haag: PRO Art Projects
item.description: Stroom Den Haag · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project, up to EUR 20,000 per applicant per calendar year. Artist fees, production and communication costs are eligible; Stroom endorses the kunstenaarshonorarium.nl fee guideline. No application fee.

item.title: Stroom Den Haag: PRO Art Program
item.description: Stroom Den Haag · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per application, up to EUR 20,000 per applicant per calendar year. Requests above EUR 5,000 require at least 30 percent co-financing of the total budget from third parties. Compliance with the kunstenaarshonorarium.nl artist fee guideline is part of the assessment. item.title: Stroom Den Haag: PRO Research
item.description: Stroom Den Haag · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 5,000 per research project, up to EUR 20,000 per applicant per calendar year. Amounts exclude VAT and grants are only awarded on demonstrable financial need. No application fee.

item.title: Zindi: Bias Bounty Mapping Equity Challenge
item.description: Zindi with Humane Intelligence, Radiant Earth, and the Heising-Simons Foundation · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 10,000 total in prizes: 1st USD 4,500, 2nd USD 2,500, 3rd USD 1,500, Best Bias Discovery USD 1,000, Best Documentation USD 500, plus 10,000 Zindi points. Free to enter.

item.title: The Photographers' Gallery: Future of Archives, Whose Archive is it Anyway? (Call for Speakers)
item.description: The Photographers' Gallery · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 200 speaker fee for each selected speaker. No application fee.

item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Flat honorarium of USD 2,500 to 5,000 per selected proposal, at the Museum's discretion

item.title: UCLA Modern Endangered Archives Program (MEAP): 2026-27 Call for Applications
item.description: UCLA Library, Modern Endangered Archives Program · deadline 16 Nov 2026 · Planning Grants up to USD 20,000 (up to 1 year) for collection evaluation, survey and inventory work before digitization. Project Grants up to USD 70,000 (up to 2 years) for digitization and metadata creation on well-organized collections, or curation of existing digital assets. Regional Grants up to USD 100,000 (up to 2 years) for digital collections drawing on three or more institutions, families or repositories around one theme, hosted by an organization with prior MEAP experience. A separate AV Grants track (up to USD 100,000, for audio, video and film) opens in April 2027. No application fee.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute AI Nodes RFP, Track I: Local Compute

No application fee.

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. In 2026, 31 American Fellows received over USD 277,390 in total funding. Awards are given in all fields, including creative arts projects.

item.title: ARC Prize 2026

item.description: Open City Documentary Festival / UCL · deadline 27 Nov 2026 · Screening fees for all selected works: GBP 275 for works over 60 min, GBP 140 for works over 40 min, GBP 70 for works under 40 min, GBP 100 for cross-platform projects (all incl. VAT)

item.title: SAT: Research-Creation Residency Program in Arts and Technologies 2026-28 (Montreal)
item.description: Societe des arts technologiques (SAT) · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CAD 10,000 grant per selected project, for individual artists and collectives alike. Also included: access to SAT workspaces during the residency periods, access to equipment and software resources subject to availability, mentoring and training activities (on site and remote), creative and technical support from the SAT teams, and documentation and archiving of the work. Travel, meals and accommodation beyond the grant are NOT covered. No application fee.

item.title: Netherlands Film Production Incentive (October 2026 round)
item.description: Netherlands Film Fund (Nederlands Filmfonds) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Cash rebate of up to 35 percent of qualifying Dutch production costs, capped at EUR 3 million per year per applicant production company. The annual budget is EUR 20 million divided across four rounds at roughly EUR 5 million per round, with an extra EUR 3 million in the first round. No application fee.

item.title: Netherlands Film Production Incentive: High-End Series (October 2026 round)
item.description: Netherlands Film Fund (Nederlands Filmfonds) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Cash rebate of up to 35 percent of qualifying Dutch production costs, capped at EUR 3 million per project per year per applicant production company. The 2026 annual budget is EUR 9.5 million across three rounds, plus an additional EUR 0.4 million in the first round carried over from 2025. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science & Safety Nodes RFP

Institutional indirect costs are not covered. No application fee.
  • EMAP / EMARE: European Media Art Platform Residencies 2027
    https://call.emare.eu/
    European Media Art Platform (EMAP / EMARE) · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 4,000 grant for the applying artist (including subsistence); EUR 2,000 for a collaborating artist (EUR 6,000 total for a duo); EUR 4,000 project budget; accommodation provided by the host; travel covered per EU ceilings; access to technical facilities and media labs. item.description:

    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs.   • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.
  • Cultuurloket DigitALL: Implementation Contribution (Implementatiebijdrage, 2026)
    https://cultuurloketdigitall.nl/implementatiebijdrage/
    Cultuurloket DigitALL · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 30,000. Covers technical modification, system integration, production and deployment costs. Hardware purchase alone is ineligible unless clearly essential to the public experience. No stated co-financing percentage. No application fee.
